title: Governor Type 1
text: IEEE type 1 linearized speed-governing steam turbine model, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Speed reference (pu)}, {Initial torque (pu)}, {Governor gain (1/droop), K (pu)} sets the gain of governor, {Lag time constant, T_1 (s)} sets the governor lag time constant, {Lead time constant, T_2 (s)} sets the governor lead time constant, {Valve position time constant, T_3 (s)} sets the time constant of valve position, {Maximum valve opening rate, U_o (pu/s)} sets the maximum opening rate of the valve, {Maximum valve closing rate, U_c (pu/s)} sets the maximum closing rate of the valve, {Maximum valve opening, on MW capability, P_max (pu)} sets the maximum opening of the valve on MW, {Minimum valve opening, on MW capability, P_min (pu)} sets the minimum opening of the valve, on MW, {Time constant for steam inlet, T_4 (s)} sets the time constant of the inlet steam, {HP fraction, K_1} sets the fraction of high-pressure shaft power, {LP fraction, K2} sets the fraction of low-pressure shaft power, {Time constant for second boiler pass, T_5 (s)}, {HP fraction, K_3} sets the fraction of high-pressure shaft power, {LP fraction, K_4} sets the fraction of low-pressure shaft power, {Time constant for third boiler pass, T_6 (s)}, {HP fraction, K_5} sets the fraction of high-pressure shaft power, {LP fraction, K_6} sets the fraction of low-pressure shaft power, {Time constant for fourth boiler pass, T_7 (s)}, {HP fraction, K_7} sets the fraction of high-pressure shaft power, {LP fraction, K_8} sets the fraction of low-pressure shaft power and {Deadband}. Values come from the instance.
